authority: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

description.en: A route on the Income Tax Department e-Filing portal for near-real-time allotment of a digitally signed electronic PAN.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Applicants using the Instant e-PAN route
verifiedConditions.claim: The official page describes the facility for applicants who possess a valid Aadhaar number.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Applicants using the Instant e-PAN route
verifiedConditions.claim: The official page states that the process requires a linked mobile number.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Applicants using the Instant e-PAN route
verifiedConditions.claim: The official guidance excludes a minor on the date of the request.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Applicants using the Instant e-PAN route
verifiedConditions.claim: The official guidance excludes a person covered by the representative-assessee definition.

unverifiedEligibility: The source describes an individual taxpayer route; this record does not define entity or foreign-applicant workflows.
The record does not establish eligibility conditions beyond the claims listed above.

requirements.claim: A valid Aadhaar number is required for the Instant e-PAN route.
A linked mobile number is required for the Instant e-PAN route as described by the official page.
Access to DigiLocker is required to fetch the accepted date-of-birth proof for the Instant e-PAN route.

processInformation.appliesTo: Applicants using the Instant e-PAN route
processInformation.claim: The official page states that the process uses Aadhaar e-KYC data and DigiLocker details.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not define a separate universal DigiLocker eligibility rule.
This record does not collect or store DigiLocker credentials, OTPs, Aadhaar numbers, or authentication secrets.

processInformation.claim: The official page directs taxpayers whose Instant e-PAN request is rejected or not serviced within 24 hours to submit a PAN request through NSDL/Protean or UTIITSL.

output.claim: The PAN is issued in PDF format and is digitally signed.

fees.applicability: Instant e-PAN route as described by the Income Tax Department
fees.claim: The official page states that the service is free of cost.
No separate authorized service-centre charge is established by the reviewed source.

fees.applicability: Not established; this record does not assume physical delivery
fees.claim: The reviewed source describes electronic PDF issuance and does not establish a physical delivery charge.

processingTime.claim: The official page describes Instant e-PAN allotment as near-real time.
processingTime.estimatedCompletionDatePolicy: Do not calculate a date; use the qualitative near-real-time description only.

sources.title: e-PAN
sources.publisher: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The FAQ identifies the eligible individual/no-PAN route, Aadhaar-linked mobile, DigiLocker, exclusions, and free-of-cost status.
claimsSupported: Instant e-PAN is an official Income Tax Department route.
The route is for applicants who possess a valid Aadhaar number.
The process uses Aadhaar e-KYC data, DigiLocker details, and a linked mobile number.
PAN is issued in digitally signed electronic PDF format.
The service is free of cost.
The service is described as near-real time.
Rejected or unserviced requests within 24 hours should be submitted through NSDL/Protean or UTIITSL.
sources.uncertainty: The record does not define entity or foreign-applicant workflows, numeric processing times, physical delivery, or service-centre charges.

sources.title: e-Filing, Income Tax Department
sources.publisher: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The Income Tax Department portal provides the official e-Filing entry point for the Instant e-PAN service.
claimsSupported: The Income Tax Department portal links to the Instant e-PAN service.
sources.uncertainty: The portal entry point does not by itself establish additional Instant e-PAN eligibility or document rules.

limitations: This record is for Instant e-PAN only, not general PAN application, correction, reprint, replacement, minor, foreign-applicant, or entity workflows.
No physical PAN delivery is assumed.
No Aadhaar number, mobile number, DigiLocker credential, OTP, or authentication secret is collected or stored by this content record.
No numeric processing duration or estimated completion date is provided.
No additional identity, address, or date-of-birth documents are added because the reviewed source does not establish them for this route.
The record is not a universal PAN checklist.

review.reviewReason: Limited route evidence is verified, but universal eligibility and several applicant categories remain unresolved.
